title: Introduction to French Studies
prerequisites_raw: FRE180H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department's French Placement Test. All students are REQUIRED to complete the French Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ ) before enrolling in ANY FSL or FRE language course for the FIRST time.
exclusions_raw: FSL305Y5 or FSL306H5 or FSL221Y1 or FSL222H1 . Not open to native speakers of French and high school graduates of Extended French or French Immersion programs.
